# Velair 1.9.0-beta.2

Velair 1.9.0-beta.2 adds household bases with room exceptions, grouped day editing and temperature-only scheduling. Template application and Planned Return are clearer across the sidebar and dashboard cards.

## ✨ Added

- Combine a household **Base** with independent room **Exceptions**, including selected rooms from a multizone Profile. Apply Profiles to their rooms, choose Default for a room, or return it to the base without creating a Mode for every combination. New automation actions support the same selections. Thanks to **@intru91** for [issue #38](https://github.com/cgonfer/velair/issues/38).
- Added day layouts for **Individual days**, **Weekdays / Weekend** and **All days** in Default and Profiles. When a group contains different schedules, compare alternatives and save the chosen base before editing the group. Grouped saves and clones preserve linked templates and presets; Default schedule cards share the editor.
- Added **Temperature only** blocks: schedule targets while leaving HVAC mode under external control, including Off where the climate integration supports it. Profiles, presets and linked templates support the same option; Room Assist and advance preparation respect Off. Existing schedules keep their activation behavior. Thanks to **@Hellsing** for [issue #42](https://github.com/cgonfer/velair/issues/42).

## 🔄 Changed

- Portable exports now use model version **18** for day layouts and temperature-only scheduling. Existing backups remain importable; older Velair versions cannot import version 18 exports. Keep a backup before testing a downgrade.

## 🚀 Improved

- Template **Apply to** now follows **Select → Review → Apply** for Default or one Profile, with independent copies, hours-only links or complete links. A shared day table supports whole-column selection and horizontal scrolling on phones. Destination and application-method changes preserve selected cells; layout changes clear them. Review identifies replacements and layout changes before one validated application.
- Active setup separates Base and Exceptions, with a collapsible household distribution summary and full-row exception controls. Profile lists distinguish base and exception usage. Shared panel and card controls adapt to narrow spaces while keeping the **Change** button in place.
- Planned Return uses consistent per-climate preparation graphs in Overview, its settings view and dashboard cards. Legends show each name and estimated start time on the same line, with compact spacing between rooms and inline expansion when more rooms do not fit. Times follow Home Assistant's time zone and time format; the climate card shows its selected room. Clearer state indicators and contextual explanations distinguish waiting, preparation, arrival-only control and suspensions without implying an estimate is actual climate activity.
- Overview and dashboard upcoming events show the next projected weekly or Planned Return control change per climate, with the source, time and target or action. Narrow views retain aligned columns with horizontal scrolling and fixed climate names. Legacy weekly next-event sensors keep their existing meaning.
- Schedule saves avoid redundant validation requests and repeated event calculations while retaining backend validation and recoverable drafts.
- Updated interface and Home Assistant action translations in all nine maintained non-English languages, and refreshed 108 translated guides for the new scheduling, Profile, template and card workflows. Installation guidance now covers resource duplication and card-picker troubleshooting.

## 🧭 Notes

- This beta builds on [1.9.0-beta.1, delivered in PR #41](https://github.com/cgonfer/velair/pull/41). That PR belongs to the previous release; the additions above describe the changes since it.
- Selecting a Mode or complete base clears room exceptions. Planned Return remains a household routine, including when controlled from a single-climate card. Changing the active setup cancels a pending return; cancellation may remain saved if the subsequent selection fails.
- Desktop card-picker behavior reported by **@novitibo** in [issue #43](https://github.com/cgonfer/velair/issues/43) remains under investigation.
- Preparation times are estimates. Live Home Assistant themes, physical devices and Companion app behavior still need real-world validation.
- After updating through HACS, restart Home Assistant and refresh the browser or companion app. If the previous interface remains visible, perform a hard refresh or clear the site cache.
